questions.solution: The correct answer is **"Condemn."** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **"Adhere'** means to stick to something or follow a rule or principle. (मज़बूती से चिपक जाना, जुड़ जाना, संसक्त होना) • **Example: ***Make sure that the paper **adheres**__ firmly to the wall.* • **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval or criticize something severely.
